name: David McAllister - § 69 - Am 68
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 69. Welcomes the 10th EU-Pakistan Political Dialogue held in Brussels on 17 July 2025, and underlines the importance of fully implementing the Strategic Engagement Plan as the framework for strengthening cooperation in political, economic, security and development matters; encourages continued cooperation on counterterrorism and counternarcotics;
